The price of waiting

$427,000

What starting at 29 instead of 19 costs you by age 65.

$200 a month · 7% a year · same habit, 10 years later

Try your own numbers

Nobody teaches this in a lecture hall. So we do.

Assumes 7% a year, compounded monthly, with each deposit at the end of the month, until 65. It shows the math, not a promise of returns. Education, not financial advice.

How it works

Every meeting ends with a move.

Something you do before you leave, not just something you heard.

  • In the room

    Every other Thursday on campus, 7 to 8 PM. Your squad, the board, and games that use market history.

  • One idea a week

    A lesson in our Discord that ends with one move you can make in 10 minutes.

  • Your squad

    A group of 5 or 6 members you keep all year. Squads pick a name and a captain and compete at every meeting.

  • We sell nothing

    No courses, no picks, no sponsors. Education, not financial advice.

In our Discord

Season 1: Don't Get Played

Our fall lessons in Discord. Each one names who profits when students don't know something, then hands you one move.

  1. Oct 1 Drop 1

    $427,000

    The $427,000 mistake

    $200 a month from 19 grows to about $815,000 by 65. Start at 29 and it's about $389,000.

    Our math: $200 a month at 7% a year, compounded monthly, age 19 to 65.
    The move

    Open a $0 brokerage account or a Roth IRA and write a one-line plan.

  2. Oct 8 Drop 2

    Under 4%

    Almost every stock is a loser

    1,082 out of 29,081 US stocks created all of the market's net wealth from 1926 to 2025.

    Bessembinder, "One Hundred Years in the U.S. Stock Markets" (2026).
    The move

    Look up the fee on any fund you own or plan to buy.

  3. Oct 15 Drop 3

    $64,000

    Your credit score is a $64,000 number

    That's the extra interest a 620 score pays instead of a 760 on one $400,000 mortgage.

    myFICO sample 30-year fixed rates, May 2026. Payment math on $400,000 is ours.
    The move

    Pull your free credit report and set card autopay to the full statement balance.

  4. Oct 22 Pre-read Posts Thu, Oct 22

    8 min

    The Basics

    Every word our drops and meetings use, in one deck.

    The move

    Read it before Nov 5. It's pinned in our Discord.

FAQ

Before you come.

Anything else, ask in the Discord or email ucdpersonalfinance@gmail.com.

Do I need to know anything about finance?

No. Every major is welcome. Start with The Basics, a short deck pinned in our Discord with every word our lessons use.

Does it cost anything?

No. It's $0 to join and there are no dues. We sell nothing: no courses, no picks, no sponsors.

What if I don't have money to invest?

Every lesson has a version for that. If you have no job, no cash or no SSN yet, there's still a move you can make that week.

Is this financial advice?

No. Everything we teach is education, not financial advice, and our lessons don't pick stocks for you.

When and where do you meet?

Every other Thursday, 7 to 8 PM, on the UC Davis campus. The next one is Thursday, Nov 5 in Hutchison 115.

What if I can't make a meeting?

New lessons go up in Discord every week, so you can keep up between meetings. For Nov 5, email Jessica Lucero at jmlucero@ucdavis.edu before the meeting to stay on the member roster.

Is UCDPF an official UC Davis club?

Yes. We're a registered student organization at UC Davis, run by students.
